name: Wander
subtitle: Free location spoofer for iPhone
description: Wander — set your iPhone's GPS anywhere. Teleport, live joystick, and realistic route playback. Free and open-source.

apps.name: Wander
apps.subtitle: Set your GPS anywhere — free.
apps.localizedDescription:
Wander sets your iPhone's location to anywhere in the world, on-device and free.

• Teleport — search an address or drop a pin and go
• Joystick — an on-screen stick that moves you in real time
• Route — drive a real road route at realistic speed (paces to the real ETA, slows for turns)
• Places — saved, recent, and famous landmark locations
• Natural jitter, km/h ⇄ mph, and an in-app setup checklist

A free, open-source alternative to paid tools like iMyFone AnyTo and Tenorshare iAnyGo. Requires iOS 17+, Developer Mode, a pairing file, and a tunnel (LocalDevVPN on a free Apple ID). See the GitHub README for setup.
apps.versionDescription: Routes now look like a real maps app: each portion is coloured by how you travel it (walk, drive, cycle, transit), shows how long that portion takes, and the other routes are labelled with their time so you can tap one. Arrival time instead of just duration, and your device's current location now shows on the map. New Timeline records where you've been — see your day, and repeat it. Search now looks around your spoofed spot instead of where your phone really is, and you can tap any place Apple draws on the map to teleport there. Look Around street-level preview is now free. Plus: live hotspot list with freshness, cooldown journal and rulebook, per-account cooldowns, roam and orbit walking, optimise stop order, more Shortcuts actions, and a cleaner, easier-to-read app throughout.
